theater_fre_quest_02_03_01:
Forgive me for boring you with such a story.
I simply wanted you to hear it.
theater_fre_quest_02_03_03:
Give us your blessing, Ottar.
When at last I am joined with "him."
theater_fre_quest_02_03_05:
Just like the guests who surrounded that couple at
their wedding, we'll be showered in heartfelt
applause and cheers.
theater_fre_quest_02_03_06: And I want you standing at the very front.
theater_fre_quest_02_03_08:
Ah, my heart races just imagining it.
I've never felt this way before.
theater_fre_quest_02_03_09:
I wonder if that bride felt like this the
day before her wedding? Ready to dance, yet
with a hollow somewhere deep in her heart.
theater_fre_quest_02_03_10:
At a time like this, most would pray to the
heavens. "Please, let tomorrow be the best
day of all."
theater_fre_quest_02_03_11:
But I won't pray.
That wouldn't be very "me," would it?
theater_fre_quest_02_03_12:
—All is as our "Goddess" wills.
We need only answer.
theater_fre_quest_02_03_14:
Our goddess shall have the finest day.
That I swear.
theater_fre_quest_02_03_19:
Wrapped in the beautiful, shining soul
that is "you," this love will become real.
theater_fre_quest_02_03_22: I think of no one but "you"—
theater_fre_quest_02_03_25: Your soul belongs to this "Goddess"—to me, Bell.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_02:
Can't believe y'all actually took down
that evil dragon.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_03:
I'd love to sing everyone's praises, but the real
hero this time has to be her.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_04:
Thank you, Ms. Harmonia.
We only won because of your song...
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_05:
You've got it backward. Thanks to all of you,
I got to sing again.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_07: It was a really beautiful song...
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_08:
I think so too! We were in the middle of a fight,
and I still got totally lost in it...
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_09:
Heh. I can't say I mind hearing
that from you two.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_10:
But it's a shame...
To think we'll never hear that song again...
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_12:
Why not? Because you already retired,
Ms. Harmonia...
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_13:
Oh, right. I suppose I did say something
like that, a long, long time ago.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_14: That was just the other day!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_15:
Once it's over, it's the past. What matters
is now. What I want to do now. And I already
know the answer.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_16: Right now, I want to sing.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_18: I'm quitting being a diva? Nope, I quit quitting!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_20:
It's official! Harmonia's Comeback
Concert is happening!!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_21: —So that's the deal. No problem with that, right?
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_22:
Of course there's a problem,
you empty-headed airhead!!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_23:
Your sudden retirement stunt
wrecked every show we had booked!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_24:
I apologized to the patrons and theater owners,
refunded the tickets—I cleaned up EVERY last bit
of your mess! Do you get that?!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_26:
At least say sorry!!
I'd like to meet whoever raised you!!
...Oh wait, that's me, I'm your patron goddess!!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_27:
I'm kidding. I really do feel bad about it.
But that's all in the past now, isn't it?
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_28:
I don't want to retire anymore.
I want to stand on that stage and sing.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_30:
...What? Why are you staring at me?
I-it's fine, isn't it? That's just how I feel...
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_31:
...Sigh. Fine. I had a feeling it would come
to this. But first, we'll head back to
Maelstra, and then...
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_34:
It has to be in this city, Orario!!
And it has to be NOW! Now, now, nowww!!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_35: Don't turn throwing a tantrum into a performance!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_36:
Bell, Ais, everyone who helped me, everyone in
this city! I won't be happy unless they all
hear me sing!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_38:
If you want to put on a show in Orario now, we
have to make the rounds AGAIN—theater owners,
patrons, the Guild, all of them! You know that?!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_39:
So if I go around apologizing to the theater
owners, the patrons, the Guild, and everyone
else involved, I can put on the show?
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_42:
I'll start with the theater owner!
Make me a list of everyone else I need to see!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_44:
She's going to make all the rounds herself?
Look at her, all full of pep... Ugh, so annoying.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_01_45:
That ruins my whole "Diva Revival Plan"!
Why'd she have to say it before I could
suggest it?!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_01:
—I am deeply sorry for what happened the
other day.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_02:
My own childish behavior caused tremendous
trouble for everyone involved—
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_03:
—and I reflect upon it with deep remorse
at every opportunity, each and every day.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_04:
The cancellation brought on by my abrupt retirement
announcement, and the many troubles it caused you
all, are greater than I can possibly imagine—
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_05:
—but that's exactly why!
I'd like you to just forget all about that stuff!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_06:
Let bygones be bygones! In fact, why not
think of this as a golden opportunity?
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_07:
Because you'll get to be part of
"Diva Harmonia's Comeback Concert"!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_08:
This show is gonna be a total success! No, success
isn't enough. A smash hit? No—a legend!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_09:
You'll be able to tell your grandkids and
beyond that you were part of that legendary
show in Orario. Guaranteed!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_10:
Is there any honor prouder than that?
What do you think? Hmm?
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_11:
Why am I so confident it'll succeed?
Isn't it obvious?
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_12:
Because I'm the one! Starring! Acting!
And singing!!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_13:
There's no stronger guarantee of a smash hit
than that. And I'll show you a me that's
different from before.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_14: It'll be an amazing show. I promise.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_15:
So chipping in a little money wouldn't hurt,
right?! You won't regret it! Pleeeeeeease!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_17:
The merchant guild folks are chipping in too.
They even said they're looking forward to it!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_18: So, where do I go next?
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_19:
I think we've covered most of the patrons.
That leaves the Guild. We need permission
from that "Guild pig" too.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_20:
Well, I could always go through
old Ouranos to arrange that, but...
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_21: It's fine, I'll pop over there myself!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_22:
There'll be lots of people at the Guild,
so it'll be great publicity, too.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_23:
I want everyone in Orario to know
I'm going back on stage to sing!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_25:
...She's amazing, Lady Harmonia.
She secured backing from every single patron.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_26:
As expected. After all, there isn't a child
in Orario right now who doesn't want to hear
her sing.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_27:
Her voice the day Cadmus fell echoed across
all of Orario. Everyone heard that
miraculous song.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_28:
Her song "charmed" this very city of adventurers,
the center of the world itself.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_29:
I see... But I don't think I've ever seen Lady
Harmonia so active and driven. She's like
a different person.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_30:
She's just so happy she can't help it.
But at the same time, she's terrified.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_32:
Yes. That's why she's putting pressure on herself.
Boasting about a guaranteed smash hit,
backing herself into a corner.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_33:
Right now her heart must be a complete jumble—
the joy of getting to sing, and the fear
of having to.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_35: Yes. Because it'll be her first time.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_02_36: Singing on stage with her own true voice—
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_01:
Aaaah! I'm so moved! I never dreamed I'd see
Lady Harmonia perform again!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_02:
I'm happy too. I thought we'd never see her
again! I've been excited ever since the show
was announced!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_03:
Who'd have thought we'd see both her "Farewell
Concert" AND her "Comeback Concert," huh?
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_05: Ms. Harmonia... You can do it...
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_07:
Mm, mm, mm... Routine, routine. Stay steady,
steady. I am Harmonia, queen of the opera...
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_08:
The house is packed... Bell and Ais are here...
Everyone's watching... Everyone's expecting
that voice from before...
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_09:
It's okay, it's okay... I'm a diva, I'm an
actress, I'm the genius Harmonia...
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_11:
What if my voice won't come out? What if I'm
off-key? What if I forget the lyrics? What
if it's not the voice everyone's expecting?
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_12: Aaaaah, no no no no no.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_13:
I'm a bug, I'm a sandal,
I'm potato puff crumbs lying in the gutter...
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_14:
...Hey, come on!
You've been distracting me this whole time!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_16:
This is my delicate pre-show time! Is it fun
messing with the leading lady's precious routine?
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_17:
I haven't said a thing. I'm just watching,
thinking how funny this girl is, as always.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_18:
But if you're about to crack, I could give
you a little head pat, you know? I used to
do that before every show, remember?
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_19:
No thanks! You're the last person
I'd ever lean on!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_20:
Knowing you, you came to check whether I'd
fallen apart before my first show in ages,
but too bad for you!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_21: Don't worry, I'm totally scared out of my mind!!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_23:
My legs are shaking like crazy,
my stomach's tied in knots—
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_24:
My head keeps flashing black and white,
and I can't even tell if I'm breathing right.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_25: I understand that the stage is scary. But—
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_26:
—I'm just as excited.
So there's no problem at all!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_28:
I'll be watching from the audience.
It's just about time. The opening bell is ringing.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_32:
Thank you. For everything, all this time.
For watching over me.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_33:
This isn't "acting."
It's all the thank-yous I could never say...
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_35:
Whoa, Lady Aphrodite is bawling her eyes out!!
And she's the goddess of beauty!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_36:
Her crying face is SO ugly!!!
And she's the goddess of beauty!!!
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_39:
I can finally sing... I can really sing...
Up on the stage... with "my real voice"...
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_41: Now, let's set off on a journey.
theater_harmonia_quest_02_03_42: Toward my brand-new stage, about to begin—
theater_hedinn_quest_01_01_05: I don't think it's over yet, though?
theater_hedinn_quest_01_01_06:
As if you'd blunder from here.
Feints would be pointless. A waste of time.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_01_07:
Quick to cut your losses, as always.
Well, I'll take that as a compliment.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_01_08:
...Boss. Isn't that Braver and Hildsleif...?
Why are two first-tier adventurers
playing a board game...?
theater_hedinn_quest_01_01_09:
Don't pry. This is a high-class bar. Even if
the gods are cooking up nasty schemes, all
we do is serve fine wine and good food.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_01_10:
Nothing that happens here leaves this room.
...Even if executives of rival familias are
playing a board game for fun.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_01_11:
I was surprised when you invited me. Halvan,
was it? This board game from the Kaios
Desert region is pretty interesting.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_01_12:
Is that sarcasm? You little imp, you mastered the
rules in no time and handed me a defeat.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_01_13:
Imp? That hurts. I only won because
"my thumb was throbbing." Otherwise
I'd be on a losing streak by now.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_01_14:
So you say.
In ten battles of strategy, you'd take six.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_01_15:
You wouldn't accept it if I said that was my
thumb's doing too, would you? ...So?
theater_hedinn_quest_01_01_17:
Why was I chosen to face the
illustrious White Knight?
theater_hedinn_quest_01_01_18:
Merely to pass the time. I claimed this game board
from among the offerings made to Lady Freya.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_01_19:
Playing it with the fools of my familia, who know
nothing but fighting, would be beyond idiotic.
The height of folly.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_01_20:
Hence, I chose you.
...And to see whether your cunning had grown.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_01_21:
Ha ha! That's honest of you!
But I don't mind a playful bit of
"reconnaissance in force."
theater_hedinn_quest_01_01_24:
Don't think I'll let you quit while you're ahead,
Prum. Today I'll finally take the lead—...
theater_hedinn_quest_01_01_26:
...I knew the rules of this game before you did.
Taking the lead here would hardly be fair.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_01_27:
...Heh, ha ha ha ha! You're ruthless most of
the time, but I like that strangely
principled side of you.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_01_28:
How irritating. Be silent.
...That was the whining of a sore loser in
the heat of defeat. Pay it no mind.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_01_29:
...Ah, I don't really get it, but they're
both such geniuses, I love them...
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_01:
Not a wasted move.
So very like you, on the board.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_02:
And yet I can't make my goddess's
expression waver even slightly.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_03:
Oh? Self-deprecating, are we?
How rare.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_06:
...Heh heh, you've "jumped."
In that case, there.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_09:
Even an uncharacteristic gambit was ensnared
in a single move. There is nowhere left to
go on this board.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_11: No. I could force a draw.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_12:
But that would merely be the result of being toyed
with for your amusement. To me, that is more
humiliating than defeat. Please forgive me.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_13:
Personally, I wanted to see more of
that frustrated face of yours.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_15:
Besides, couldn't you play it?
A move that draws out the "unknown."
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_16:
If you'd struggled and struggled to the very end,
a miracle might have been born.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_17:
...To begin with, no mortal could ever hope
to beat a deity who has grasped the very
crux of the game.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_18:
If one in a hundred million could, it would be
one who seizes luck, or one with an irrational
"intuition" like that impudent Braver.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_19:
A strategist like myself, bound by reason
from first move to last, cannot overturn
this board.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_20:
Heh heh... You even treat yourself as a
piece, place yourself on the board, and step
back to watch.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_21:
Ever the view of a "king."
Even after I freed you from a king's duties.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_22: Just as you say. I find it wearisome, myself.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_24:
You play at humility, but in truth, you're
terribly arrogant. In that last game too, you
were pressing me to make a "choice between two."
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_25:
That wasn't to find a path to victory...
It was to test me, wasn't it?
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_27:
You despise waste more than anything.
There's no way you'd do it just for fun.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_28:
Heh heh. What were you trying to discern, I
wonder?
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_30:
...When cornered by a deity, fall "silent."
Your usual trick.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_31:
But precisely because you're like that, you
can see what my children who blindly obey my
every word cannot.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_32:
When I'm in trouble, I'll rely on you after all.
That's best.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_33:
I am overjoyed beyond measure. I shall ease
your boredom and serve as your right hand.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_34:
...That aside.
May I ask one thing?
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_36: I would request one more game.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_37:
...Heh heh heh, ah ha ha ha!
And after you said you were no match for me!
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_38:
A new strategy has come to me.
It should prove some amusement for you.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_39:
Why not just say it plainly? That you want to win.
That would be cuter. More lovable.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_02_41: Heh heh—you really are a terribly sore loser.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_03_01:
Freya Familia versus the Familia Alliance.
In the midst of the Great Familia War—
theater_hedinn_quest_01_03_02:
I despise the incompetent. But I value the
weak who struggle to become capable.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_03_03: With you, I can cross swords as planned.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_03_04:
—Your opening "advance" is passable.
But keep on like that and you'll be devoured.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_03_05:
Ngh...?!
Then if I deploy the left flank here...!
theater_hedinn_quest_01_03_06:
—A blunder, idiot. Did you forget
the quadruplets have it covered?
theater_hedinn_quest_01_03_07: Ngh...! Then the reserve unit in the center...!
theater_hedinn_quest_01_03_08:
—Out of the question. If you reinforce, do
it on the right. Why let what's in front of
you mislead you?
theater_hedinn_quest_01_03_09:
Braver, the only one in all Orario who can
devour even the omniscience of the gods—
theater_hedinn_quest_01_03_10:
Make the seeds he sowed sprout, now.
Grow at an accelerating pace mid-battle.
I will not tolerate you standing still.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_03_11:
Search, search, search!!
For a clue to where Mr. Hedin is trying to go!
theater_hedinn_quest_01_03_12: Search it all out in this single second!!
theater_hedinn_quest_01_03_13:
I'll steal Mr. Hedin's aim, his thinking!
And use it! If I can turn the enemy's plan
against him and take him down with me...!!
theater_hedinn_quest_01_03_14:
—Yes. Show me your ability.
Sink your teeth into the likes of me.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_03_15:
If, after many sacrifices, the board falls
into place... the final key will be—
theater_hedinn_quest_01_03_17:
A slow learner, and a catastrophically
inefficient idiot at that...
theater_hedinn_quest_01_03_19:
Lady Freya. Just as you said—
it seems I am a terribly sore loser.
theater_hedinn_quest_01_03_20:
Countless pieces have built this board after
a miraculous tightrope walk. The insight of
a goddess of beauty may surpass even this—
theater_hedinn_quest_01_03_21:
—but this one battle, I will win.
All for your sake.
theater_her_quest_03_01_02:
Why do I keep losing to Artemis no matter
how many rounds of rock-paper-scissors we play?!
theater_her_quest_03_01_03:
C-calm down, Hestia. You're the one who suggested
rock-paper-scissors to decide who'd ride
the wyvern with Bell, aren't you?
theater_her_quest_03_01_04: ...Bell. You have dust in your hair.
theater_her_quest_03_01_05:
Huh? Huh?! Lady Artemis?!
Y-you're too close!
theater_her_quest_03_01_06:
Hey, Artemiiis!
Quit trying to flirt with MY Bell every
chance you get!
theater_her_quest_03_01_07:
Hey! Hestia! I said stop thrashing around!
You're scaring the wyvern, and besides—
theater_her_quest_03_01_11:
What is it with these useless goddesses...?
Don't any of you have the wisdom
expected of a god?!
theater_her_quest_03_01_12:
Please don't be too hard on Hestia.
She can be careless at times,
but she means no harm.
theater_her_quest_03_01_13:
Why are you defending her like it has nothing
to do with you?! You accidentally gave away
all our food, Lady Artemis! You're no better!
theater_her_quest_03_01_16:
Still... can't believe the wyvern's saddle broke.
I can patch it up, but a real repair job...
theater_her_quest_03_01_17:
Yeah, Lord Hermes said it's a long trip, so
he went to find someone who can fix it
properly...
theater_her_quest_03_01_18:
—No need to worry. I found a craftsman
who'll fix it at top speed. We can leave
before sundown.
theater_her_quest_03_01_20:
He really is a god whose only outstanding
qualities are efficiency and knowing the angles...
theater_her_quest_03_01_21: Ha ha ha, that's harsh, Lili!
theater_her_quest_03_01_22:
—Now then. Blessing in disguise, but we've got
some time on our rushed trip. Why not enjoy a
little sightseeing while the saddle's being fixed?
theater_her_quest_03_01_24:
Yep. Great sights, great food, great fun—
this village happens to be quite the tourist spot.
theater_her_quest_03_01_25:
There are a few places I'd like to show you—
especially you, Artemis. There's a local specialty
that's perfect for you and Bell.
theater_her_quest_03_01_26:
...I see.
Then, Orion, I would like to go there.
theater_her_quest_03_01_28:
Wha...?! We can't leave Mr. Bell alone with Lady
Artemis, who committed the outrageously enviable
act of hugging him the moment they met...!
theater_her_quest_03_01_29:
Then Lili's coming too! Come on, Lady Hestia,
quit moping and let's go!
theater_her_quest_03_01_31:
Ah... my beloved...
Here I swear to love you for all eternity...
theater_her_quest_03_01_32:
Huh...? Is that a proposal?! I love you! I
love you so much! Ahh... I'm so glad we came
here...
theater_her_quest_03_01_33:
Wh-what is this suspicious place...?
It's nothing but couples flirting everywhere...
theater_her_quest_03_01_34:
D-don't tell me, Hermes! You brought us to some
indecent place...? I'm disappointed in you!
Well, I always figured you were that type!
theater_her_quest_03_01_35:
Even I wouldn't take virgin goddesses to that kind
of place. It's just that the specialty here is
a bit... unusual—
theater_her_quest_03_01_36:
—Okay! Bring it right out! This village's
famous "Twin Lovey-Dovey Juice"...!!
theater_her_quest_03_02_01:
"Twin Lovey-Dovey Juice"!! A man and woman
whose hearts are one drink a single juice
through two straws—
theater_her_quest_03_02_02:
—to affirm their love! Or so a certain
self-proclaimed strongest, invincible goddess
of beauty taught the villagers!
theater_her_quest_03_02_03:
They followed her teachings and made the juice
a local specialty, and when rumors spread that it
grants eternal love, it became a huge hit!
theater_her_quest_03_02_04:
Before long it was called "Twin Lovey-Dovey
Juice," and it became this village's
undisputed claim to fame!
theater_her_quest_03_02_05:
Wh-who was it?
What goddess of beauty filled the children's
heads with something so dumb...?
theater_her_quest_03_02_06:
For some reason, thinking about the kind of
goddess who'd say that makes a dark urge
well up deep in my chest...
theater_her_quest_03_02_07:
Well, that's not the essence of
"Twin Lovey-Dovey Juice."
theater_her_quest_03_02_08:
What matters is it's the perfect specialty
to liven up a trip and add some color to
your memories!
theater_her_quest_03_02_10:
...All right, Orion. Shall we try it?
I'll drink from this side.
theater_her_quest_03_02_12:
Hooold on just a minuuute!
What is with you?! I can't let my guard down
for a second!
theater_her_quest_03_02_13:
If anyone's going to affirm their love with Bell,
who's better suited than me, his patron goddess?!
Nobody, that's who!
theater_her_quest_03_02_15:
C'mon, Bell. Let's swear eternal love or
whatever and share this juice together—
theater_her_quest_03_02_18:
What do you think you're doing, helping yourself?!
This isn't the kind of thing a goddess
and her follower should do—
theater_her_quest_03_02_19:
It should be shared with a beloved companion who's
built a bond through the ups and downs of the
Dungeon! Right?! Mr. Bell?! RIGHT?!
theater_her_quest_03_02_20: Lili?! You're kind of scaring me?!
theater_her_quest_03_02_21:
Ha ha, I figured it'd turn out like this.
Whew... It's tough being popular, huh?
theater_her_quest_03_02_22: Lord Hermes, stop laughing and help me!
theater_her_quest_03_02_23:
Let's see... Then to be fair,
how about deciding with rock-paper-scissors?
theater_her_quest_03_02_24: Hmm... That shouldn't leave any hard feelings.
theater_her_quest_03_02_25: A rematch from the wyvern, huh? Bring it on!!
theater_her_quest_03_02_26:
Lili won't lose! She'll seize a lovey-dovey moment
with Mr. Bell, and someday it'll become
eternal loooove!!
theater_her_quest_03_02_27:
Here we go!
Rock, paper, scissors—!!
theater_her_quest_03_02_29:
Ah, um... yes... But this kind of thing
is... kind of embarrassing...
theater_her_quest_03_02_30:
GWAAAAAAAAAAH!! WHYYYYY?!
Why can't I ever beat Artemis?!
theater_her_quest_03_02_31:
Th-their faces so close together over that
juice... Ngh, ahh... Lili is SO jealous!!
theater_her_quest_03_02_32:
Artemis, goddess of chastity, doing such a classic
couple thing. The folks up in the heavens would
fall over if they saw this—
theater_her_quest_03_02_33:
—May you savor that sweetness. That unknown
moment. A little peace and excitement for
the maiden goddess.
theater_her_quest_03_03_02:
What is it this time? Deep in the woods like
this... If it's another weird tourist spot
like before, I won't let it slide.
theater_her_quest_03_03_03:
Relax. The villagers have loved this place since
ancient times. It's a genuine, honest-to-goodness
scenic spot.
theater_her_quest_03_03_04:
Now, Bell. Artemis.
Burn this breathtaking view the world
has made into your memories—
theater_her_quest_03_03_05:
Amazing...
I can't believe there was a place like this
past the forest...
theater_her_quest_03_03_06:
Yes. Whether made by human hands or by nature...
either way, it is a miracle all its own.
theater_her_quest_03_03_08:
But Hermes... What's gotten into you, volunteering
as a tour guide at a time like this?
theater_her_quest_03_03_09:
Deep down... you know our schedule
doesn't really have room for this, right?
theater_her_quest_03_03_10:
At any time, under any circumstances, showing the
wonders of travel is my duty as the god of travel.
theater_her_quest_03_03_11:
...Well, Artemis seems to be having fun,
so I guess it's fine.
theater_her_quest_03_03_12: Now then... I'll go pick up the repaired saddle.
theater_her_quest_03_03_13: Ah, sorry for putting you through all this.
theater_her_quest_03_03_14:
Hey now, of course it's a favor you owe me.
I'll collect on this saddle repair someday too.
theater_her_quest_03_03_16:
After all, repairing a custom-made item. A
rush job, no less. Ahh, that was pricey.
theater_her_quest_03_03_19:
Oh... I won't name names, but there's always been
this guy who acts super generous whenever he's
scheming something no good.
theater_her_quest_03_03_21:
And on the flip side, whenever he comes along
making you feel indebted, it's usually
something kind-ish.
theater_her_quest_03_03_22:
Hmm, who could that be?
Doesn't ring a bell.
theater_her_quest_03_03_23:
Who knows... Who could it be?
But I bet that twisted guy is thinking...
theater_her_quest_03_03_24:
...that the gods' games of deception are
a real pain in the neck.
theater_hes_quest_14_01_01:
Grrr...!! Nwaaaaaaaaah!!
What do I do?! What do you—AAAAAH!!
theater_hes_quest_14_01_02:
Mommy~
That goddess with the big boobies is yelling.
theater_hes_quest_14_01_03:
Honestly, don't point! She must be troubled by
something beyond our understanding. Come on, let's
go buy decorations for the Holy Night Festival—
theater_hes_quest_14_01_04:
Hah... hah... hah...! Picture Bell clearly! With a
goddess's discerning eye, divine his deepest
desiiiiiire...!!
theater_hes_quest_14_01_05:
...Lord Miach, what is that...?
She's been at it for a while.
theater_hes_quest_14_01_06:
Hmm... I can't abandon a dear friend writhing
in such distress... though getting involved
is a little frightening too.
theater_hes_quest_14_01_07:
—Hestia. What's wrong? You've been wandering
the shop and shrieking for a while now.
theater_hes_quest_14_01_08:
Miach...? And Nahza too.
When did you get there?
theater_hes_quest_14_01_09: We've been here... the whole time.
theater_hes_quest_14_01_10:
Sorry! With the Holy Night Festival coming up, an
emergency—my number-one top-priority mission—has
come up. I lost my cool!
theater_hes_quest_14_01_11:
...Have you gotten caught up in trouble again?
We may be a tiny familia, but if there's anything
we can do, we'll lend a hand.
theater_hes_quest_14_01_12:
It's not exactly trouble...
But, um... could you hear me out?
theater_hes_quest_14_01_13: Hmm... A Holy Night Festival gift for Bell, then.
theater_hes_quest_14_01_14:
Yeah. Bell can't stand sweets, so cake and candy
are out. The stuff he's interested in is weapons
and armor—
theater_hes_quest_14_01_15:
But he's got custom-made gear from Welf,
his exclusive smith, and there's NO WAY
anything I give could top the Hestia Knife!
theater_hes_quest_14_01_16:
I thought about heroic sagas he'd like, but he's
probably read most of them... What on earth
should I give him...?!
theater_hes_quest_14_01_17: What can I even do for that boy?!
theater_hes_quest_14_01_18:
Come on, tell me, you two! A super-duper-amazing
present that'll make Bell shout, "Goddess, you're
the best, I love you!"!!!
theater_hes_quest_14_01_19:
Lady Hestia, please calm down...
Also, your face is too close...
theater_hes_quest_14_01_20:
I see... But anything you give him,
I think Bell would be glad to receive.
theater_hes_quest_14_01_21: ...Yeah. Bell's a sweet kid, after all.
theater_hes_quest_14_01_22:
But... that's exactly why I want to give him an
incredible present that'll surprise him...
and make him smile from the heart.
theater_hes_quest_14_01_23:
That calls for an unimaginable surprise! And
it has to be "something" that strikes deep
in his heart...
theater_hes_quest_14_01_24:
Nwaaaaaaaah!! BELLLLLL!!
What do you truly want, besides that
loathsome "longing" of yours?!
theater_hes_quest_14_01_25:
I see... So her bizarre behavior stems from
how deeply she cares for her child.
theater_hes_quest_14_01_27:
Don't say that, Nahza.
Even gods get swept up by emotion and
agonize over the unknown.
theater_hes_quest_14_01_28:
...Hestia, I could help as a fellow "man,"
like Bell, and Nahza as a fellow "child."
theater_hes_quest_14_01_29:
Ahh! Thank you, Miach!
A best friend really is the best thing to have!!
theater_hes_quest_14_01_30:
Sigh... I have a feeling something ridiculous
is about to start again...
theater_hes_quest_14_02_01:
But a Holy Night Festival present... I hear it's
something you give to thank those who've looked
after you day to day.
theater_hes_quest_14_02_02:
I tell him that all the time! That's why
it's so hard to make it feel "special,"
different from usual.
theater_hes_quest_14_02_03:
Miach, have you ever gotten a present
like that that made you happy?
theater_hes_quest_14_02_04:
...Hmm. Recently a lady regular gave me a
hand-knit sweater as an early Holy Night
Festival present. That made me happy.
theater_hes_quest_14_02_05:
It was heartfelt, carefully made, and warm...
and the "LOVE" written across the front
was rather stylish.
theater_hes_quest_14_02_06:
WHAAAAAAAAAAAAAAT?! I thought those pajamas
looked weirdly unlike him... So that's what
that was...!
theater_hes_quest_14_02_07:
Lord Miach... Who was it...? Who?
Thieving cats sneak in among customers.
She must be eliminated...
theater_hes_quest_14_02_08:
Quit thinking such scary thoughts! Look! Nahza!
What would make YOU happy to get?!
theater_hes_quest_14_02_11:
But... the hand-knit sweater annoys me...
but clothes... might be clever...
theater_hes_quest_14_02_13:
...You wear them every day, so unless the guy's
really dense, he should notice. Supposedly.
theater_hes_quest_14_02_15: Though the ultra-dense type is a problem...
theater_hes_quest_14_02_16:
Ah ha ha... Well, Bell's pretty close
to ultra-dense too...
theater_hes_quest_14_02_17:
But it might just work, you never know...
Right! Let's try a clothing store!
theater_hes_quest_14_02_20:
Bell doesn't seem that into clothes to begin with,
so I can't picture a gift he'd be happy with.
theater_hes_quest_14_02_21: The classic clothing gift for a man is... a suit?
theater_hes_quest_14_02_22:
I thought about that, but it's kinda ordinary...
It doesn't feel very Holy Night Festival...
theater_hes_quest_14_02_23:
Then how about that? During the Holy Night
Festival, people wear that red outfit and go
around handing out presents, don't they?
theater_hes_quest_14_02_24:
Santa Bell would be cute, but... hmm...
I can't picture him being thrilled about it...
theater_hes_quest_14_02_25:
Isn't there something good... like... a matching
outfit that makes Bell and me one in body
and soul, that kind of thing...
theater_hes_quest_14_02_27:
Wh-what's with you two?!
What's with those "so it's YOUR desire
after all" faces?!
theater_hes_quest_14_02_28:
I'm just purely, honestly, from the bottom of my
heart wanting my beloved Bell to smile—
theater_hes_quest_14_02_31:
THIS IS IIIIT!!!
This is the ultimate Best of Bell outfit!
theater_hes_quest_14_02_32:
It's no exaggeration to say this outfit exists for
Bell! Hey, clerk! Let me try it on, right now!!
theater_hes_quest_14_02_33:
At any rate, it seems she found something
she likes. Good, good.
theater_hes_quest_14_03_01:
Ladies and gentlemeeeen!
This is the extra-special present
I can give Bell!
theater_hes_quest_14_03_02:
Christmas Bunny with Maiden Goddess Hestia!
C'mon, Bell! Let's hop-hop together!!
theater_hes_quest_14_03_04:
What's this, what's this? Kind of a weak
reaction? Is this present so wonderful it's
left you speechless?
theater_hes_quest_14_03_05:
There's so much to point out...
First of all, weren't you giving Bell clothes...?
theater_hes_quest_14_03_06:
In the face of the grand goal of making Bell
smile, little details like that don't
matter!
theater_hes_quest_14_03_07:
I don't get the point of the bunny outfit
either...
theater_hes_quest_14_03_08:
Indeed. You said you wanted something
festive, but I've never heard of any Holy
Night Festival legends involving rabbits.
theater_hes_quest_14_03_09:
Hm? The colors are kinda festive, right?
If I come hopping out in this on the Holy Night...
it'll be the perfect surprise!
theater_hes_quest_14_03_10:
Um... I'm sorry.
I don't understand at all.
theater_hes_quest_14_03_11: Hmm... So, in short, anything would have done.
theater_hes_quest_14_03_12:
Tsk, tsk, tsk. There's a deep reason behind this.
To put it simply—
theater_hes_quest_14_03_15:
Bell means bunnies! And by wearing this and becoming
a bunny, Bell and I will transcend the wall between
god and human and be perfectly in sync!
theater_hes_quest_14_03_16:
If Bell has qualms about romance between
a god and a mortal... then I'll just
hop right over that wall!
theater_hes_quest_14_03_17:
Ahh, a snowy Holy Night. The second chapter of
Bunny Me and Bell's new love story begins—
theater_hes_quest_14_03_19:
Whaaaaaaaaaat?!
G-g-g-Goddess turned into a bunny?!
theater_hes_quest_14_03_20:
That's right! You and I are both bunny-wunnies
now! No need to worry about a little thing
like the difference in our races!
theater_hes_quest_14_03_21: Fwoooooooah!! Then tonight is Hop-Hop Night!
theater_hes_quest_14_03_22:
I want to hop-hop together with you!!
Come on, Goddess, as fellow bunnies—
let's hop, hop!
theater_hes_quest_14_03_23:
Yeah! Hop! Hop!
Ahh, I'm so happy! Bell! BELLLLL!
theater_hes_quest_14_03_25: Whoa, that goddess is making a crazy face.
theater_hes_quest_14_03_26:
Don't look! Gods have... all sorts of things
going on. Yes, all sorts!
theater_hes_quest_14_03_28:
Yes. It seems Hestia has resolved
the matter in her own mind.
theater_hes_quest_14_03_29:
Oh, and they even threw in a second one for free!
The first one makes Bell melt, and the second one
finishes him off—
theater_hes_quest_14_03_30:
Heh heh... ehehehe... My heart's going hop-hop!
Ahh, maybe I'll bunny-hop all the way home, yeah!
theater_hogni_quest_01_01_02:
[Destroy for eternity, by the might of the
demon blade—]
theater_hogni_quest_01_01_06:
If you would receive the goddess's favor, devour
the deep darkness, transcend good and evil,
and unleash the jet-black torrent—
theater_hogni_quest_01_01_09:
(Ugh...! He's looking at me like "what is he
talking about?!" No, no, I'm not one of those
"chuuni" types the gods talk about—)
theater_hogni_quest_01_01_10:
Ah, uh... um...!
D-d-don't look at me like that—
theater_hogni_quest_01_01_13:
Y-you... understand?
My chaos words, drenched in crimson blood?
theater_hogni_quest_01_01_14:
I don't get all of it... but "jet-black torrent"
sounds like the name of a special move.
It's really cool!
theater_hogni_quest_01_01_17:
...!! N-no idle chatter!
K-kindle the unwavering jet-black flame,
and rebel...!
theater_hogni_quest_01_01_18:
Y-yes, sir!
That means come at you with everything, right?
theater_hogni_quest_01_01_20:
I see... He thinks I'm cool...
Not that I do it so people will think that.
Ehehe~
theater_hogni_quest_01_01_21:
Gross...
He's been like that since training ended today.
theater_hogni_quest_01_01_22:
Apparently Bell Cranel praised his usual
nonsensical babble. Whatever the case—
theater_hogni_quest_01_01_24:
Maybe I... could really be friends with him...
No, no, no way! First I have to forge
a bond as his mentor.
theater_hogni_quest_01_01_26:
Hah—Wh-wh-what is it... my nemesis? You call my
name, seeking... slaughter? Or perhaps the
destruction of the world...?
theater_hogni_quest_01_01_27:
This is a discussion to fulfill the
goddess's will. Wipe that spineless look off
your face. Focus.
theater_hogni_quest_01_01_29:
—Moving on. Regarding that foolish rabbit's
treatment and his "baptism"...
theater_hogni_quest_01_02_01:
—We have decided to drive the foolish rabbit to
the brink. But we've been too lenient. To make
him fall, we must impose still greater severity.
theater_hogni_quest_01_02_02:
You especially, Hogni.
Cast aside your foolish sentiment and face
the "baptism."
theater_hogni_quest_01_02_03: I-I am a cold-blooded knight. Sentiment is...
theater_hogni_quest_01_02_04:
It's just... he kind of got what I was saying...
He's such a good-natured human,
I got a good feeling, you know...
theater_hogni_quest_01_02_05:
Like, maybe a soul mate has appeared?
My heart's kind of racing at the thought...
theater_hogni_quest_01_02_08:
If soul mates like you started multiplying,
they'd be executed on sight, idiot.
theater_hogni_quest_01_02_09:
Y-you don't have to put it like that!
Ah, ah, ah...
theater_hogni_quest_01_02_10:
O-Ottar...! You who have observed that rabbit...
surely you grasp a fragment of my feelings,
the "Black Heretic"...?
theater_hogni_quest_01_02_12:
He's saying that you, who've had dealings with the
foolish rabbit, should understand the words
of this outcast.
theater_hogni_quest_01_02_15:
...Heh, heh heh! I am the infant of
darkness, born alone upon the solitary
summit... This, too, is fate...
theater_hogni_quest_01_02_16:
(B-but... Hedin, who's been with me since
the Isle of Hjaðningar...)
theater_hogni_quest_01_02_17:
(He's foul-mouthed, and we've tried to kill each
other, but he always translates what I say...)
theater_hogni_quest_01_02_18:
(He's way too harsh, but he does keep an eye on
Bell, all things considered. Maybe that's
actually love in disguise...)
theater_hogni_quest_01_02_20: Stop looking over here. You make me sick.
theater_hogni_quest_01_02_21:
...M-my eternal rival—
what lies behind those sharp words of yours...?
theater_hogni_quest_01_02_22:
Why... do you desire such a brutal "baptism"?
Could it be... you harbor an affection close
to mine...?
theater_hogni_quest_01_02_24:
(Eeeek, that was REAL abuse!
Ah, ahh... Bell, save meee...!!)
theater_hogni_quest_01_02_25:
Our conclusion stands. Conduct the "baptism" with
all your might, without the slightest mercy.
Until he kneels before Lady Freya.
theater_hogni_quest_01_02_26:
B-b-but... if we go too far,
won't Lady Freya be sad too...?
theater_hogni_quest_01_02_27:
Fool. Don't measure the goddess's will by your
shallow thinking. All is for the goddess's
"desire"—that is what the "baptism" is for.
theater_hogni_quest_01_03_01:
Shortly before the War Game between
the Freya Familia and the Hestia Familia—
theater_hogni_quest_01_03_04:
H-heh heh... I was lost in thought, pondering
how to slaughter the rabble before the masses.
Now begins the feast of blood and curses!
theater_hogni_quest_01_03_05: Just admit you were too nervous to move. Idiot.
theater_hogni_quest_01_03_06:
Th-that's not... Well, it's partly true, but...
quit reading the depths of my heart like that!
theater_hogni_quest_01_03_07:
If you intend to bring foolish feelings onto
the battlefield, I'll finish you off from
behind myself.
theater_hogni_quest_01_03_08: Th-that... that part, at least... is fine.
theater_hogni_quest_01_03_09:
L-like I told Alfrik and the others. Even if I
face Bell on the battlefield... I absolutely
won't hesitate.
theater_hogni_quest_01_03_11:
Bell's... a good guy. I want to talk to him more.
I even want to see how much he's grown, but...
theater_hogni_quest_01_03_12: Lady Freya is my reason for living...
theater_hogni_quest_01_03_13:
I have no intention... not even the slightest...
of putting that on the scales.
theater_hogni_quest_01_03_15:
If we win this battle and get Bell,
Lady Freya's wish comes true...
and she'll smile for sure.
theater_hogni_quest_01_03_16:
For her smile... I'll do anything.
You're the same, right, Hedin?
theater_hogni_quest_01_03_19:
Get out on the battlefield.
If you have time to babble creepily about resolve.
theater_hogni_quest_01_03_22:
—with the slash of my beloved Victim Abyss,
I shall make you an offering to the goddess
of beauty. There is no right or wrong.
theater_hogni_quest_01_03_24:
All for the "desire" of the great goddess
who saved us and embraced us with heavenly
love—
theater_lef_quest_05_01_01:
Phew...
This outfit Loki brought, the "furisode"...
theater_lef_quest_05_01_02:
So many layers, and tying the "obi" is so
complicated. It's beautiful, but just
putting it on is a chore.
theater_lef_quest_05_01_03: Mm... People from the Far East are amazing.
theater_lef_quest_05_01_04:
Anyway, I think we've figured out how to put
it on... so let's change for today. It's
getting late.
theater_lef_quest_05_01_05:
Tomorrow, let's put on the "furisode" again
and go out somewhere!
theater_lef_quest_05_01_06:
Um... if possible, I'd like to
stay like this... I think.
theater_lef_quest_05_01_08:
Tonight... I don't want to sleep, I guess.
In the "furisode"... with you, Lefiya...
theater_lef_quest_05_01_10:
Wh-wh-wh-what does that mean...?!
Ms. Ais, um, what do you...?!
theater_lef_quest_05_01_12: You fell asleep right after saying that!!
theater_lef_quest_05_01_14:
A-and if you fall asleep like that,
your lovely "furisode" will get wrinkled—
theater_lef_quest_05_01_15:
Hah... M-maybe I should give her a lap pillow and

theater_lef_quest_05_01_16:
Y-yes... This isn't about any improper
feelings...! It's just to keep her lovely
"furisode" neat...!
theater_lef_quest_05_01_19:
AAAAAAAAAH, Ms. Ais?! Th-th-this is...!!
It's purely for the "furisode"...!
theater_lef_quest_05_01_21:
Ah, um, yes... Very much so.
You dozed right off...
theater_lef_quest_05_01_22:
I see... I decided I wouldn't sleep tonight...
I thought if I was with you, Lefiya,
I wouldn't get sleepy...
theater_lef_quest_05_01_25:
N-n-no way! When I'm with you, Ms. Ais,
I'm wide awake, totally buzzing...!
theater_lef_quest_05_01_27: Um... but why don't you want to sleep...?
theater_lef_quest_05_01_31:
A-are you okay...? If you're that sleepy,
maybe you should just sleep...
theater_lef_quest_05_01_32:
Um... just for today. I really... want to
stay awake. Lefiya... please, watch me so I
don't fall asleep...
theater_lef_quest_05_01_34:
If that's what you wish, Ms. Ais, I'll keep
you awake with all my heart and soul and
strength...!!
theater_lef_quest_05_02_03:
Ngh... Ms. Ais!!
I'm so sorry...!!
theater_lef_quest_05_02_06:
Th-that's not enough to wake her... Then a pinch?
No, no, I could never be so rude to Ms. Ais...!!
theater_lef_quest_05_02_07:
Besides, it'd be cruel to spoil such an adorable
sleeping face... But I have to keep my promise
to Ms. Ais!! Aaaaah!!
theater_lef_quest_05_02_09:
Wahyaa?! ...Ah, Ms. Ais.
Thank goodness. You're awake...
theater_lef_quest_05_02_10:
I fell asleep... again.
Staying up late is hard...
theater_lef_quest_05_02_11:
You seem to be sleeping deeper and deeper...
If you fall asleep again, I don't know if
you'll come back...
theater_lef_quest_05_02_14:
Ugh... That's it! Instead of waking her once she's
asleep, I should strike first and find a way
to keep her awake...!
theater_lef_quest_05_02_15:
Ms. Ais! I'll prepare something super-duper
wonderful, so please try to stay awake
just a little longer!
theater_lef_quest_05_02_18:
Ms. Aiiiiiiiiiiis!
Please, try eating thiiiiis!!
theater_lef_quest_05_02_20:
The "toshikoshi soba" Loki bought since she's
hooked on Far Eastern culture! Add potato puffs,
and it's a must-eat dish for you, Ms. Ais!
theater_lef_quest_05_02_21: I call it! "Jyaga Maru Nanban Soba"!
theater_lef_quest_05_02_23:
Go ahead, go ahead!
Apparently it's supposed to be very good luck.
theater_lef_quest_05_02_24:
*Slurp*... The soba, the salty broth, and
the potato puffs are linking arms to create
the ultimate flavor?
theater_lef_quest_05_02_25:
Truly, this is the ultimate fusion of the Far East
and the Labyrinth City...? And the world is wrapped
in the ultimate, crispy, deep-fried love...?
theater_lef_quest_05_02_26:
I don't quite follow what you're saying...
but I'm relieved you're enjoying it so much...
theater_lef_quest_05_02_27:
Phew... That was delicious.
Thank you, Lefiya.
theater_lef_quest_05_02_28:
Not at all! You're wide awake now... right?
Then let's stay up together until morning—
theater_lef_quest_05_02_29:
But... once my tummy's... full...
Zzz...
theater_lef_quest_05_02_32:
But... Ms. Ais's face, sleeping happily on a full
stomach... I want to paint it, such a blend
of cuteness and beauty—
theater_lef_quest_05_02_33:
Wait, I have a mission Ms. Ais entrusted to me!!
Ms. Ais, please wake uuuuup!
theater_lef_quest_05_03_01:
Hah... hah... hah...
U-um... Ms. Ais. Are you awake?
theater_lef_quest_05_03_03:
Y-yes... I was just writhing between your
unwitting cuteness and my mission...
theater_lef_quest_05_03_05:
More importantly, are you okay, Ms. Ais?
You're way past your limit for sleepiness, right?
theater_lef_quest_05_03_06:
I think... I'm starting to feel okay?
And besides... it's almost time.
theater_lef_quest_05_03_11: Wow... It's already gotten pretty bright...
theater_lef_quest_05_03_13:
Nope! This "furisode" has so many layers,
it's nice and warm.
theater_lef_quest_05_03_14: Besides, the fresh morning air feels great...
theater_lef_quest_05_03_15:
...It really does.
The new wind... of the new year... feels so nice.
theater_lef_quest_05_03_17: Ah... It's almost time. We have to hurry.
theater_lef_quest_05_03_19:
Um... a place I've wanted to go for a long, long
time. A place I couldn't go alone.
theater_lef_quest_05_03_21: It's not... the Dungeon or anything, is it?
theater_lef_quest_05_03_22:
No. It's just up ahead.
Let's go, Lefiya.
theater_lef_quest_05_03_24:
Ah, so you two came as well. Heh... It seems
Ais managed to stay awake this year.
theater_lef_quest_05_03_25:
And dressed in Far Eastern clothes, too...
You're really into it.
theater_lef_quest_05_03_26:
Captain...?
What is everyone doing here?
theater_lef_quest_05_03_28:
Here, take a look over there.
Looks like it's just about time.
theater_lef_quest_05_03_32:
In the Far East, they call the sun that rises
at the start of the year "hatsuhinode" and
pray to it for health and safety, it seems.
theater_lef_quest_05_03_33:
Following that custom, we come here at the
start of every year to pray for our
familia's safety... and prosperity.
theater_lef_quest_05_03_34:
Then, Ms. Ais...
you wanted to stay awake to see this
"first sunrise"...
theater_lef_quest_05_03_35:
Ais falls asleep every year.
I thought this year would be no different.
theater_lef_quest_05_03_36:
Because Lefiya... was with me.
I thought maybe this year I could stay awake...
theater_lef_quest_05_03_39:
I'm... really happy too, getting to see
such a beautiful view together with you, Ms. Ais!
theater_lef_quest_05_03_40: ...Why don't you two make a wish as well?
theater_lef_quest_05_03_42: (I wonder what Ms. Ais is wishing for?)
theater_lef_quest_05_03_44:
(Next year... no, not just next year.
Please let me always stay by Ms. Ais's side
like this...)
